verdict.rationale: The Intelligent Commerce REST endpoints are documented under a versioned path (/acp/v1/instructions, /acp/v1/tokens), so the APIs are versioned at least by URL. Nothing in the pack describes a versioning policy, a changelog, or how or when versions are deprecated. The product page also carries a maturity caveat that it is still in development and deployment. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, a documented versioning and compatibility guarantee, a changelog or sunset timelines, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
